newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Group sees better 1997 earnings.
newsitem.headline: CS Group sees better 1997 earnings.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group said it expected structural improvement in earnings power this year.
"For the current year Credit Suisse Group expects structural imporvements in earning power throughout the group and, in particular, in Swiss business," it said in a statement on 1996 results.
It quoted new chief executive officer Lukas Muehlemann, who took the post on January 1 under a major reorganisation at the bank group, as outlining a number of main goals for 1997.

It said these goals were "an increase in profitability in all business areas, a continuation of the rapid and systematic implementation of the refocusing measures and the completion of the remaining restructuring projects on schedule".
It said Muehlemann also pledged to pursue systematically the selective expansion of activities in attractive markets and product areas.
